reasons.plausibility: Al has very limited solubility in BCC refractory metals and strongly tends to form intermetallics (e.g., with Zr, Hf), making retention of a single-phase BCC structure with 25–40% Al substitution highly unlikely and contradicting well-established phase equilibria.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific compositions, characterization methods, and quantitative rejection criteria for both density reduction and mechanical property retention.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a physically unsound premise (high Al solubility in BCC refractory HEA) that would be immediately dismissed by an experienced researcher, wasting experimental effort.
